newsitem.title: UK: S&P, FGV sign agreement on Brazil rating service.
newsitem.headline: S&P, FGV sign agreement on Brazil rating service.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Ratings Services said on Thursday it had signed an agreement with Fundacao Getulio Vargas (FGV) in Brazil, to facilitate the establishment of a new Brazilian rating service.
The agreement covers training and marketing cooperation between the two firms, S&P said in a statement.

"This agreement will serve the local and international interests of Brazilian issuers, intermediaries and investors, who benefit from independent, reliable credit ratings," said Leo O'Neill, president and chief rating officer for S&P.
The agency said it has similar cooperative agreements with ratings services in Argentina, Chile, India, and Indonesia, and has 17 offices worldwide.
FGV, based in Rio de Janeiro, is a leading Brazilian institution in the fields of economics, business, and management, S&P said.
